item.title: Iranian Generals Kicking Themselves For Not Just Meeting Over Zoom
item.description: TEHRAN — Iranian military leaders are reportedly "really kicking themselves" for not just having their latest meeting over zoom.

item.title: Ayatollah To Give Speech As Soon As Officials Find The Rest Of His Body
item.description: TEHRAN — Iranian officials have promised that Ayatollah Khamenei will give a speech just as soon as they have located the rest of his body.

item.title: Mamdani Orders Flags At One World Trade Center Flown Half-Staff To Mourn Ayatollah
item.description: NEW YORK CITY — Mayor Zohran Mamdani has ordered all flags at One World Trade Center to be flown at half-staff to mourn the death of Ayatollah Khamenei.

item.title: British Citizens Politely Ask If They Can Be Liberated From Radical Islam Next
item.description: LONDON — British citizens have politely asked if perhaps they could be next on the list for liberation from radical Islam.
